name: C&C: Shockwave
description: A large fan-made overhaul of Zero Hour with new units, generals and balance (ModDB Editor's Choice 2008).
notes: Download it from ModDB. It arrives as a Windows installer, usually inside a .zip: choose that file, or run the installer into an empty folder and choose the folder. Rallypoint unpacks the game archives and never starts Shockwave's own launcher, so the same download works on macOS and Windows.

name: C&C: Shockwave Chaos
description: A deliberately over-the-top add-on for Shockwave with lots of new and reworked units, generals and abilities.
notes: Download the .zip from ModDB, unpack it if you like, then choose the .zip or its folder. Rallypoint plays it together with Shockwave, so nothing in your Shockwave folder is changed.

name: Cold War Crisis
description: A total conversion of Zero Hour (version 469), with its own movies, cursors and content.
notes: Download the manual installation .zip from ModDB (about 550 MB) and choose it here; no installer is run. It replaces the game's content, so it can't be played together with Shockwave or Chaos.
